title: Compose a Pipeline
prompt:
Implement `Compose`: given a list of `Func<int, int>`, return one function applying them IN ORDER (first element first). Empty list = identity.

```csharp
static Func<int, int> Compose(List<Func<int, int>> steps);
```

tests.name: order matters
tests.hint: Fold left to right: acc = step(acc) for each step in order.

tests.name: empty is identity
tests.hint: Return x => x when there are no steps.
